narrative.overview: Signaller replaces Mainline's red/blue GBR-evoking duotone with an independently-designed identity built around a real UK rail banner repeater signal. Platform White is the ground (~70%), Rail Navy carries structure and authority (~20% — the full-bleed header, the home status card, primary buttons), and Signal Red is the one spotlight colour reserved for a single live action or alert per screen (~10%). Archivo carries headlines and signage-like UI moments; Inter carries body copy and tabular data. There is exactly one theme — dark mode was dropped entirely, not redesigned.
keyCharacteristics: Platform White ground, Rail Navy for structure/authority, Signal Red as the one spotlight accent.
Full-bleed Rail Navy header at every width; fixed bottom tab bar carries primary nav on mobile.
The home dashboard's next-departure card is a signature full-navy 'journey status card' with a Display-scale white inset row.
Archivo (500-800) for headlines/signage moments; Inter (400-600) for body/UI/tabular data.
Generously rounded: 18px cards, 10px controls, pill buttons/chips — except the signal mark, a true circle.
Light only. No dark theme, no OS-driven switching, no toggle.

rules.name: The Spotlight Rule
rules.body: Signal Red is the only saturated accent and lights up at most one thing per screen. Rail Navy is structure, not decoration.

rules.name: The Signal-Text Rule
rules.body: Colour never stands alone on live status: a chip or label always states the condition in words alongside its colour.

rules.name: The One-Theme Rule
rules.body: There is no dark theme, no prefers-color-scheme switch, no toggle. Signaller is designed once for Platform White.

dos: Do treat Signal Red as a spotlight — one action or alert per screen, never a background fill.
Do keep the header a full-bleed Rail Navy band at every width.
Do build the home dashboard's next-departure card as full Rail Navy with a Display-scale white inset row.
Do give mobile a fixed bottom tab bar with icon + label and a Signal Red live-alert dot.
Do round every corner generously — pill buttons/chips, 18px cards, 10px inputs — except the mark, a true circle.
Do keep every signal chip paired with text stating the condition.
donts: Don't reintroduce a second saturated accent — Signal Red does all the pointing.
Don't ship a dark theme, a prefers-color-scheme switch, or a toggle.
Don't show the signal mark's arm at any angle but 45°, recolour it, or thin its stroke.
Don't reintroduce the double-arrow mark or Rail Blue from the previous (Mainline) world.
Don't square off corners; 18px/10px/pill is the form language.
